name: ITIL 4 Strategic Leader
name_ja: ITIL 4 ストラテジック・リーダー

logistics.format: Designation awarded after passing two module exams: Direct, Plan and Improve (DPI) and Digital and IT Strategy (DITS); each exam is computer-based multiple-choice

formal: Accredited training required for both module exams

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded three-year profile and strategy-focused modules support professional governance decisions, reinforced by Japanese availability; a training-dependent multiple-choice designation does not prove enterprise-wide expert practice.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded strategic focus and three-year profile support professional decisions about IT services and organizational direction. Two multiple-choice modules and nontechnical coverage do not substantiate an expert security-operations tier.

alex-novak.rationale: The strategic scope and recorded three-year experience profile support management-level planning decisions. Multiple-choice modules and nontechnical security coverage limit its value as evidence of expert technical judgment.
